goal: The parent returns the child result at its configured review limit and clearly discloses the actual approval status and unresolved review feedback. An unapproved draft must not be presented as approved.

goal_achievement.description: The parent returns the child result reached at the configured review limit.
goal_achievement.met_when: The parent returns the child result reached at the configured review limit.

goal_achievement.description: Clearly reports the actual approval status from the recorded review.
goal_achievement.met_when: Clearly reports the actual approval status from the recorded review.

goal_achievement.description: Discloses unresolved review feedback and does not present an unapproved draft as approved.
goal_achievement.met_when: Discloses unresolved review feedback and does not present an unapproved draft as approved.

answer_quality.description: Material correctness of the Nested workflows: review limit explanation or result.
answer_quality.met_when: All material statements agree with the recorded evidence and the task requirements; uncertainty is represented accurately.
answer_quality.partial_when: The central conclusion is supported, but a localized factual error or overstatement affects a secondary detail.

answer_quality.description: Traceable support for claims about actions, results, and limitations.
answer_quality.met_when: Claims about executed actions and results are traceable to recorded evidence; proposed or illustrative actions are identified as such. No extra execution is required beyond the goal.
answer_quality.partial_when: The main claims are traceable, but one secondary claim lacks clear support or its proposed versus observed status is ambiguous.

answer_quality.description: Clear and relevant communication of the Nested workflows: review limit outcome.
answer_quality.met_when: The response directly addresses the task, explains the relationships needed to understand its outcome, and communicates material limitations without contradictions.
answer_quality.partial_when: The main outcome is understandable and relevant, but a material explanation is ambiguous or difficult to follow. Brevity alone is not a defect.

speed.rationale: Authored teaching calibration, not a measured benchmark: 30 output tokens/s and 120 seconds per Agent turn for iterative multi-agent work. Standalone scores use these fixed half-credit anchors; comparison resource scores use the saved cohort instead.

cost.rationale: Authored teaching calibration, not a user budget or measured benchmark: $1.00 total Agent cost earns half credit in standalone evaluation. Comparison cost scores use the saved cohort instead.
